description.sub_name: 精密機械設計與製造實務
description.sub_ename: PRACTICAL DESIGN AND MANUFACTURING OF PRECISE MACHINE
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨於培養學生對工具機的設計與製造流程有基本的概念與認知，並能依設計流程實際操作。所以本課程將從機密機械概論導入，說明各類型工具機設計概念與關鍵零組件應用，進而介紹製造與量測等運作實務，有效結合學理與實務操作。
description.describe_eh: This course is aims to recognize the concepts of the machine tools design and manufacturing process, which will provide students can actually operate according to the design process. Therefore, this course will introduce the fundamentals of precision machines, explain the design concepts of various types of machine tools and the application of key components, and then introduce the operational practices such as manufacturing and measurement, effectively combining academic theory and practical operations.
